testcase.name: both protocols work on separate connections to the same port
a stale If-None-Match falls through to a full 200
suffix ranges, open-ended ranges and multi-range reassembly all line up
the child-channel hook is installed before the bootstrap acceptor
a handshake delivered one byte at a time is reassembled intact
keep-alive reuses one HTTP connection for several requests
a handshake whose length prefix looks like an HTTP verb prefix is still classified correctly
HEAD reports the length with no body
a legacy server-list ping passes straight through
a vanilla handshake reaches the vanilla pipeline byte-for-byte and the sniffer detaches
a Range request returns 206 with the exact slice and Content-Range
every relayed buffer arrives with exactly one reference and is fully released
an unsatisfiable range returns 416 with bytes */length
the harness is armed: leak detection is at the most aggressive level
GET /uas/pack/{id} streams the exact archive with cache headers
